name: Scherer Metals - 1299 E. 58th Avenue, Denver
old_description: Founded in 1896, Scherer Metals has a rich history shaped by generations of dedicated leadership; from its early days under Frank Scherer & Sons, to the stewardship of the Koenig family, and beyond. We are proud to carry that legacy forward with the same passion, craftsmanship, and commitment to excellence that have defined us for over a century.
about:
Scherer Metals operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1896 as Frank Scherer & Sons. The business passed to the Koenig family, which has stewarded the company through multiple generations, maintaining a focus on architectural metal fabrication.

The shop provides custom architectural and decorative metal fabrication, including shearing, punching, bending, polishing, MIG and TIG welding, and patina finishing. On-staff draftsmen and engineers translate concepts into build-ready designs, while project managers oversee complex jobs from start to finish. The facility also handles restoration and repair of existing metal components and stocks finishing materials such as corner guards and kick plates.

Scherer Metals serves architects, contractors, and designers across commercial and residential projects. Its portfolio includes railings, cladding, furniture, and decorative metalwork, with patina finishes applied using Sculpt Nouveau products, which the company distributes.

The company cites its 129-year history and certified welding staff as key differentiators, emphasizing on-time delivery and the ability to turn client visions into reality. As a distributor of Sculpt Nouveau metal paints, patinas, and clear coats, it offers a single source for both fabrication and specialty finishes.
